fhirFacade.signatureCredential: Adapter config must reference fhir.signatureWebhookId; it must not store shared secrets inline.

degradation.note: Missing or disconnected FHIR adapter returns OperationOutcome and never fabricates write success.

fhirFacade.note: FHIR R4/R5 runtime facade is owned by OPT-01 and mounted under the INTEG-01 integration bus. Runtime capability declares implemented read/search/create surface only.

knowledgeRuntime.note: 第三方只通过 v1 稳定门面读取当前机构生效版本并写入标准临床上下文；不得选择离线交付文件、领域或资产版本。

commonHeaders.name: Idempotency-Key
commonHeaders.purpose: deduplicate external retries where the endpoint has side effects

commonHeaders.name: X-MedKernel-Timestamp
commonHeaders.purpose: anti-replay timestamp for HMAC signature verification

commonHeaders.name: X-MedKernel-Fhir-Adapter
commonHeaders.purpose: tenant-scoped FHIR adapter id that references signing webhook and whitelist

get.summary: Read AdapterHub orchestration status and source-level degradation for current tenant.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Disconnected or missing source adapters are reported honestly and do not block clinical flow.

get.summary: List third-party integration adapters for current tenant.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Adapter health fields may be NOT_CONNECTED when no real connector is reachable.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key and a stable adapterId; duplicate adapterId in one tenant is rejected.

degradation.note: Creation records configuration only; it must not fabricate connectivity.

get.summary: Read the third-party integration field contract for the current hospital runtime release.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: The contract is generated from the relational field catalog and does not depend on external connectivity.

put.summary: Update protocol, configuration, or status of an existing adapter.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated vendor console submissions; adapterId remains the business key.

degradation.note: Updating configuration does not imply a successful connection.

post.summary: Generate a persisted data quality snapshot from current MPI and adapter facts.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated operator report-generation commands.

degradation.note: Missing mappings, stale heartbeats, and disconnected adapters are recorded as gaps, not converted to success.

get.summary: List third-party business interface onboarding lifecycles for current tenant.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Onboarding may be ONLINE while connectivity remains NOT_CONNECTED; the blocker must stay visible.

post.summary: Create an adapter or FHIR facade onboarding lifecycle record.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key and stable onboardingId; duplicate onboardingId in one tenant is rejected.

degradation.note: Creation records lifecycle evidence only; it never fabricates external connectivity.

post.summary: Advance one onboarding lifecycle stage with operator evidence.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated stage-advance commands; onboardingId anchors the lifecycle.

degradation.note: Stage advancement is separate from live connector reachability; NOT_CONNECTED remains a blocker.

get.summary: List regional collaboration sources and trust grades for current tenant.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Regional source evidence remains queryable when the external network is disconnected.

post.summary: Register one regional collaboration source with OPT-07 trust grading evidence.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key and stable sourceId; duplicate sourceId in one tenant is rejected.

degradation.note: Ungraded sources are rejected; disconnected sources do not block clinical flow.

get.summary: Read tenant adapter health distribution and per-adapter status.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Disconnected external systems remain visible as NOT_CONNECTED.

post.summary: Manually trigger health check for one adapter.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key when an operator may retry the same health check command.

degradation.note: The check must not fabricate HEALTHY or a synthetic RTT.

get.summary: List webhook subscriptions for current tenant.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: A missing callback target does not hide the webhook configuration.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key and stable webhookId; duplicate webhookId in one tenant is rejected.

degradation.note: Creation stores subscription metadata; callback delivery is verified separately.

post.summary: Generate a local webhook signature preview without claiming network connectivity.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated operator tests when the same payload is reused.

degradation.note: The response reports SIGNATURE_GENERATED and connectionStatus NOT_TESTED because no external request is sent.

post.summary: Receive a signed inbound webhook, map it with the exact release-train version, and create a clinical event.

idempotency.requirement: The messageId in request body is the business idempotency key; retries must return the original processing state.

degradation.note: Invalid signature, unknown webhook, missing field mapping, mutable termMappingId, or unresolved runtime-release terminology snapshot is rejected and audited.

idempotency.requirement: The messageId in request body is the business idempotency key; retries must not create duplicate side effects.

degradation.note: No real connector means NOT_CONNECTED compensation log; never fabricate sent status.

get.summary: Page through integration message audit logs.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Logs remain queryable when external systems are down.

idempotency.requirement: Safe read; Idempotency-Key is not required.

degradation.note: Dead-letter evidence remains visible during outages.

post.summary: Replay one callback dead-letter message while preserving original evidence.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated callback replay commands; replay creates a traceable compensation message.

degradation.note: Callback replay must keep honest failure state when no connector is reachable.

post.summary: Retry delivery for one integration message log.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated operator retry commands; messageId anchors compensation.

degradation.note: Retry without a reachable connector stays NOT_CONNECTED or DEAD_LETTER.

post.summary: Replay one dead-letter message while preserving original evidence.

idempotency.requirement: Provide Idempotency-Key for repeated replay commands; replay creates a traceable compensation message.

degradation.note: Replay must keep honest failure state when no connector is reachable.
